sources.name: Bob Pratt, 'Operação Prato', MUFON/Pratt document set hosted by The Black Vault — https://documents.theblackvault.com/documents/MUFON/Pratt/prato.pdf

desc: Brazil transferred substantial Air Force holdings on unidentified aerial phenomena into the Arquivo Nacional, making it one of very few states whose military UFO records sit in a citizen-accessible public archive rather than behind a classification review. Its documented cases are unusually strong: the 19 May 1986 incident, in which Brazilian Air Force fighters were scrambled against multiple radar-tracked objects and the Air Minister subsequently briefed the press, and the January 1996 Varginha episode, which in July 2026 became the subject of a formal US congressional request to the FBI and CIA. Brazil is the board's clearest example of records law working.
label: Brazil
